In the years that followed, no one with magic dared step foot in Camelot, on pain of death. That is until Prince Arthur's twenty fifth birthday, where he makes a royal decree inviting a sorcerer to Camelot, in an attempt to put aside old prejudices and unite the people of Camelot. Which is a lovely speech, but Merlin knows it's a trap.
